# symbolicExplicitConstraintTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [symbolicExplicitConstraintTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/symbolicExplicitConstraintTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  exudyn.symbolics.solvers.SolveExplicit with coordinates fixed by algebraic equations (#3238), eliminated as
#           Exudyn's explicit solver eliminates CoordinateConstraints to the ground: a chain of three mass points on
#           spring-dampers under gravity, coordinates of two of them fixed, with the user items of UserItemCreator
#           (CreateCoordinateConstraint is an ObjectGenericDAE) on the SymbolicSystem against the built-in items with
#           mbs.SolveDynamic: explicit Euler alike, RK44 of order 4 against a fine solution (Exudyn's RK44 does not fix
#           the coordinates in its stages, #3240); a fixed coordinate with an offset keeps the value of its equation;
#           a NumpySystem whose mass matrix couples the fixed coordinate with a free one against the system without the
#           fixed coordinate; a constraint between two coordinates is refused.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-11-04
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.symbolics.userItems import UserItemCreator
from exudyn.symbolics.systemModel import SymbolicSystem, NumpySystem
from exudyn.symbolics.solvers import SolveExplicit
import numpy as np

testError = 0
def Check(condition, message):
    global testError
    if not condition:
        exu.Print('symbolicExplicitConstraintTest: ' + message)
        testError += 1

def Settings(solverType, endTime=0.5, steps=500):
    settings = exu.SimulationSettings()
    settings.timeIntegration.endTime = endTime
    settings.timeIntegration.numberOfSteps = steps
    settings.timeIntegration.verboseMode = 0
    settings.solution.file.write = False
    settings.timeIntegration.solverType = solverType
    return settings

def Chain(user, offset=0., coupling=False):
    """three mass points on spring-dampers; mass 0 fixed in y and z, mass 2 in z; with the user items of UserItemCreator
    or the built-in items"""
    SC = exu.SystemContainer()
    mbs = SC.AddSystem()
    creator = UserItemCreator(mbs) if user else mbs
    oGround = creator.CreateGround()
    masses = [creator.CreateMassPoint(referencePosition=[0.5*(i + 1), 0, 0], initialDisplacement=[0, -offset if i == 0 else 0, 0],
                                      initialVelocity=[0, 0.2*i, 0.1 if i == 1 else 0], mass=1 + i, gravity=[0, -9.81, 0])
              for i in range(3)]
    for (item0, item1) in [(oGround, masses[0]), (masses[0], masses[1]), (masses[1], masses[2])]:
        creator.CreateSpringDamper(itemNumbers=[item0, item1], stiffness=400, damping=2)
    for (mass, coordinate) in [(masses[0], 1), (masses[0], 2), (masses[2], 2)]:
        creator.CreateCoordinateConstraint(itemNumbers=[mass, None], coordinates=[coordinate, None],
                                           offset=offset if coordinate == 1 else 0.)
    if coupling:
        creator.CreateCoordinateConstraint(itemNumbers=[masses[1], masses[2]], coordinates=[0, 0])
    if user:
        creator.Record()
        mbs.variables['creator'] = creator #the recordings live as long as the system
    mbs.Assemble()
    return mbs

#the chain on the SymbolicSystem: explicit Euler as Exudyn's explicit solver; RK44 of order 4, which Exudyn's is not
#with eliminated coordinates, as it does not fix them in the stages (#3240), so against a fine solution of it
u = 0
system = SymbolicSystem(Chain(user=True))
mbsBuiltIn = Chain(user=False)
mbsBuiltIn.SolveDynamic(Settings(exu.DynamicSolverType.ExplicitEuler))
result = SolveExplicit(system, Settings(exu.DynamicSolverType.ExplicitEuler))
error = np.max(np.abs(result['q'][-1] - mbsBuiltIn.systemData.GetODE2Coordinates()))
Check(error < 1e-10, 'ExplicitEuler: ' + str(error))
u += round(float(np.sum(np.abs(result['q'][-1]))), 10) #rounded: the last bits of numpy differ between platforms

result = SolveExplicit(system, Settings(exu.DynamicSolverType.RK44))
resultFine = SolveExplicit(system, Settings(exu.DynamicSolverType.RK44, steps=2000))
mbsBuiltIn.SolveDynamic(Settings(exu.DynamicSolverType.RK44, steps=50000))
error = np.max(np.abs(result['q'][-1] - resultFine['q'][-1]))
errorBuiltIn = np.max(np.abs(result['q'][-1] - mbsBuiltIn.systemData.GetODE2Coordinates()))
Check(error < 1e-9 and errorBuiltIn < 2e-6, 'RK44: ' + str(error) + ', ' + str(errorBuiltIn))
Check(np.max(np.abs(result['q'][:, [1, 2, 8]])) == 0. and np.max(np.abs(result['q_t'][:, [1, 2, 8]])) == 0.,
      'RK44: the fixed coordinates move')
u += round(float(np.sum(np.abs(result['q'][-1]))), 10) #rounded: the last bits of numpy differ between platforms

#an offset: the coordinate keeps the value of its equation, not zero as for Exudyn's explicit solver
system = SymbolicSystem(Chain(user=True, offset=0.05))
result = SolveExplicit(system, Settings(exu.DynamicSolverType.RK44))
(q, q_t) = (result['q'][-1], result['q_t'][-1])
residual = system.AlgebraicEquations(q, q_t, np.zeros(0), np.zeros(system.nAE), 0.5)
Check(np.max(np.abs(residual)) < 1e-10 and abs(q[1] + 0.05) < 1e-10, 'offset: ' + str(residual) + str(q[1]))
u += round(abs(q[1]), 8)

#a mass matrix that couples the fixed coordinate with the free one: the free one as in the system without the fixed one
stiffness, fixedValue = 100., 0.1
coupled = NumpySystem(np.array([[2., 1.], [1., 2.]]), lambda q, q_t, t: np.array([-stiffness*q[0], 1. - stiffness*q[1]]),
                      initialState=([0., 0.2], [0., 0.]),
                      constraints=lambda q, q_t, y, z, t: np.array([q[0] - fixedValue]),
                      constraintJacobian=lambda q, q_t, y, t: np.array([[1., 0.]]), numberOfConstraints=1)
reduced = NumpySystem(np.array([[2.]]), lambda q, q_t, t: np.array([1. - stiffness*q[0]]), initialState=([0.2], [0.]))
resultCoupled = SolveExplicit(coupled, Settings(exu.DynamicSolverType.RK44, 1., 200))
resultReduced = SolveExplicit(reduced, Settings(exu.DynamicSolverType.RK44, 1., 200))
Check(np.max(np.abs(resultCoupled['q'][:, 0] - fixedValue)) < 1e-12 and np.max(np.abs(resultCoupled['q'][:, 1] - resultReduced['q'][:, 0])) < 1e-14,
      'coupled mass matrix')
u += round(float(resultCoupled['q'][-1, 1]), 10)

#a constraint between two coordinates is no fixed coordinate
try:
    SolveExplicit(SymbolicSystem(Chain(user=True, coupling=True)), Settings(exu.DynamicSolverType.RK44))
    Check(False, 'a constraint between two coordinates is not refused')
except ValueError:
    pass

u += testError
exu.Print('solution of symbolicExplicitConstraintTest=', u)

exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
